questions.stem: To estimate the area under a curve, you can split the region into:
questions.explanation: The area under a curve can be estimated by dividing it into strips. Using trapeziums (the trapezium rule) or rectangles gives a good approximation.

questions.stem: On a velocity-time graph, the area under the curve represents:
questions.explanation: The area under a velocity-time graph gives the displacement (distance travelled in a given direction).
